name: horn-shift
steps: While driving, shift gear and sound the horn with the demo controls.
The signals add their cues to the retained Engine play.
hud: Feel the revs. Find your rhythm.
RPM and throttle smoothly blend idle and rev sounds and change their pitch. Horn and gear-change signals add sounds while the engine keeps running.
One little car. A changing sound.
Listen as the engine finds its voice.
Drag to cruise · hold W to accelerate
SPACE / IGNITION   S / BRAKE   G / GEAR   H / HORN
